About Binance
Binance Exchange is the leading crypto exchange by trading volume and users, with customers in over 180 countries and regions. Capable of processing more than 1.4 million orders per second, Binance is one of the fastest trading platforms in the world. The platform focuses on security, robustness, and execution speed—attracting enthusiasts and professional traders alike.

Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, Web3 features, and more. We leverage the power of digital assets and blockchain to build an inclusive financial ecosystem to advance the freedom of money and improve financial access for people around the world.

About the Pioneer Talent Program 
Are you an early-career professional ready to kickstart your career in the dynamic world of blockchain? Binance’s Pioneer Talent Program is designed to nurture ambitious individuals like you. The program offers full-time roles where participants will gain hands-on expertise via a tailored training curriculum and personalized 1:1 mentorship from industry leaders. Dive behind the scenes of the world’s leading blockchain ecosystem while building the skills to thrive in Web3. Launch your career with purpose—join us in shaping the future of digital innovation.

Candidates with up to 5 years of relevant work experience

Are you an early-career professional ready to kickstart your career in the dynamic world of blockchain? Binance’s Pioneer Talent Program is designed to nurture ambitious individuals like you. Who May Apply
Candidates with up to 5 years of relevant work experience

About the Role

We are seeking a Research Data Scientist who combines rigorous research thinking with a drive to see findings land in production. You will conduct original research in generative AI and LLMs applied to crypto-native problems — spanning reasoning under uncertainty, agent reliability in adversarial financial environments, and multi-modal market intelligence.

This is a research-first role at the intersection of three critical frontiers: post-training alignment and reasoning for financial agents, efficient inference and test-time scaling, and multi-agent coordination in open, adversarial environments. The goal is real-world impact — not just papers, but agents that trade, analyze, and act for millions of users.

You formulate research questions, design rigorous experiments, build evaluation frameworks, and collaborate with engineers to bring research into production.

job.job_title: Product and Funnel Optimisation Manager - CIS
job.job_description:
As a Product & Funnel Optimisation Manager, you will own the optimisation of the local user journey across Binance products. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, CRM, Design, and Marketing teams to improve activation, conversion, retention, and overall user experience.

You will be responsible for identifying funnel bottlenecks, launching experiments, configuring local product experiences, managing market-specific product content and localisation, and using data to drive continuous product improvements. This role requires a combination of analytical thinking, hands-on execution, and strong ownership.

Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are looking for a QA Engineer who has strong capabilities in platform product testing, can understand complex backend service call flows, and is interested in AI-driven testing and end-to-end automation.

This role will be responsible for functional testing of platform products, API testing, end-to-end test design, and exploring the application of AI in test case coverage and automated testing.

Our product supports personalized experiences at scale, where different users may see different features, UI, and content in the app. Behind this are algorithm- and strategy-driven systems, while the frontend relies on dynamic UI rendering. Therefore, this role requires strong end-to-end testing capability, system-level thinking, and the ability to validate complex cross-functional scenarios.

About the Role:

We are seeking an Exchange Regulatory Business Manager to take end-to-end ownership of regulatory engagement and approval processes across our FSRA regulated exchange business lines, including Spot, Futures, and Options. This is a critical role that sits at the intersection of product, compliance, and regulatory strategy.

Reporting to senior leadership, you will be responsible for understanding product designs from the ground up, preparing regulatory submissions, and negotiating directly with regulators to secure and maintain the necessary approvals for our exchange products and market expansions. You will act as the primary regulatory interface, ensuring that Binance's product roadmap aligns with regulatory expectations while advocating for commercially sound outcomes.

This role requires deep experience in traditional finance, a strong track record of dealing with financial regulators, and the ability to bridge between business teams and regulatory authorities. You will also provide regulatory support to local entities as needed, ensuring consistent standards across jurisdictions.

The candidate is required to work within UAE working hours and willing to travel there as required, and must be bilingual in Chinese Mandarin and English to effectively coordinate with internal stakeholders and regulators.

We are building a suite of tokenized equity capital markets products from the ground up, and are looking for a Research Analyst to join a small, high-impact team. This is a 0-to-1 opportunity for a self-starter who wants to help shape products from inception through launch.

The role is highly cross-functional, working closely with internal stakeholders in a fast-moving environment where initiative and ownership are essential.

About the Role
We are seeking a highly skilled Research Scientist/Engineer to advance the reasoning and planning capabilities of large foundation models. In this role, you will enhance model performance across the entire development lifecycle—including data acquisition, supervised fine-tuning (SFT), reward modelling, and reinforcement learning—while driving innovations in reasoning and decision-making. You will synthesise large-scale, high-quality datasets through rewriting, augmentation, and generation techniques to strengthen foundation models during pretraining, SFT, and RL stages. A key part of the role involves solving complex tasks using System 2 thinking and applying advanced decoding strategies such as MCTS and A*. You will design and implement robust evaluation methodologies, teach models to interact with external tools, APIs, and code interpreters, and build agents and multi-agent systems capable of addressing sophisticated real-world problems.

We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Data-driven based business is the core in helping us to use the cloud-native platforms to serve tens of millions of crypto-currency users. Engineers and Data Scientists across the company use the data platform to do interesting and impactful analyses for continuous innovations.

As a data scientist, you will have the opportunity to leverage rich data (PB-level scalability) and state-of-art machine learning infrastructure to develop data products that are used by our tens of millions of crypto-currency users. You will collaborate with a strong team of engineers, data analysts, business operation and product/marketing managers to define and build solutions, features, algorithms and products based on our rich data and cutting-edge machine learning technology.  
 
To be successful in this role, you must be a quick learner, stellar machine learning skills with rich and solid experience from inception to business impact, strong communication capabilities and work well in cross-functional teams (e.g. with data users from different marketing and consumer team). This is a great opportunity to enhance your machine learning /data science skills in markets and familiarize with Blockchain based technology and etc while making a real impact on Blockchain and Crypto-Currency technology globally.

We have multiple openings available and many more are coming due to our rapid growth of the business. Sample projects include:
 
- User behavior and pattern analysis: KYC, Anti-Money Laundry, and abnormal user automated recognition to provide our users with safe and more accurate information service
- Digital data asset: obtain the blockchain based data to perform chain-based data analysis, prediction and recommendations.
- Personalized recommender system: leverage of our PB-scale data warehouse to perform in-depth analysis and recommender system for our end-users
- Data driven customer feedback and satisfaction analysis: leverage of machine learning techniques to understand customer’s feedback and satisfaction with proven data evidence and analysis

We are building our own IDC infrastructure from the ground up. job.job_title: Senior Large Language Model Algorithm Engineer/Expert
job.job_description:
Calling top-tier AI and Web3 innovators from around the globe!  Binance is building the world’s foremost crypto and Web3 platform—and we’re just getting started. We’re assembling a lean, elite LLM Algorithm & Data Science Team (3–5 members) to pioneer next-generation AI solutions in finance, blockchain, and beyond. If you’re young, passionate, and driven by cutting-edge research, this is your moment to make history.

What You’ll Build:

We’re not here to retrofit yesterday’s models—we’re here to invent tomorrow’s:

-Web3 Data Lake LLM
Ingest and reason over massive on-chain and off-chain datasets to power real-time insights.

-Trading System LLM
Design intelligent trading agents, signal generators, and strategy-optimization engines.

-Compliance and Regulatory LLM 
Automate compliance, travel-rule enforcement, and on-chain forensics at scale.

.…and beyond
From customer-service agents and personalized navigation experiences to completely new AI-powered Web3 applications.

Your creations will underpin multiple internal products—customer support bots, trading-signal dashboards, compliance workflows, user-experience agents—while also bootstrapping entirely new AI-Web3 innovations.

We're shaping the core platforms and services that support Binance’s global ecosystem, optimizing user interactions, and enhancing operational efficiency. If you're passionate about building scalable, secure solutions that drive crypto adoption, join us and be part of a team that's redefining the digital asset experience.
Why Binance
• Shape the future with the world’s leading blockchain ecosystem
• Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure
• Tackle unique, fast-paced projects with autonomy in an innovative environment
• Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning
• Competitive salary and company benefits
• Work-from-home arrangement (the arrangement may vary depending on the work nature of the business team)

Binance is committed to being an equal opportunity employer. We believe that having a diverse workforce is fundamental to our success.
By submitting a job application, you confirm that you have read and agree to our Candidate Privacy Notice.

Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, Web3 features, and more. We leverage the power of digital assets and blockchain to build an inclusive financial ecosystem to advance the freedom of money and improve financial access for people around the world.

The Global Events team is responsible for delivering Binance's most strategic and high-profile experiences around the world. From flagship conferences and executive summits to VIP experiences, community events and creator programmes, we create memorable moments that strengthen our brand, engage our users and support business growth.

Our team manages a diverse portfolio of global events, including flagship events, sponsorship activations and community initiatives. We work cross-functionally with Marketing, Product, Business Development, Legal, Security, Operations and regional teams to execute world-class events across multiple markets.

As a fast-paced global team, we thrive in an environment where no two events are the same. We value ownership, adaptability, collaboration and a willingness to solve complex challenges.

Responsible for end-to-end quality assurance across Web and App (mobile) surfaces — combining automated and exploratory testing to ensure product stability, compatibility, and interaction experience from the user's perspective. The core requirement is cross-platform testing capability (Web + App), with the ability to design and maintain an automated testing system and to think deeply about troubleshooting and user-experience-oriented quality.

In one sentence: This role is the quality gatekeeper for Web/App products — someone who can write automation scripts, test interaction experiences, investigate data issues, and use engineering methods to replace manual testing with systematic automated quality coverage. Not a manual tester — a QA engineer with real coding ability.

Superside is hiring an Account Director to lead and grow a portfolio of strategically important enterprise customers. You’ll own the full customer lifecycle, from pre-sale scoping through delivery, renewal, and expansion, ensuring customers see Superside as a long-term creative partner.

This role sits at the intersection of customer strategy, commercial growth, and delivery. You’ll lead cross-functional teams, manage senior stakeholders, and drive retention, expansion, and high-quality delivery across complex accounts.
Why Join us?

Superside's vision is to create equal opportunities globally by accelerating the world’s transition to online work. With that in mind, we're building a fully remote company that attracts people where they are.

Remote-first. Customer-led.
Remote isn’t just a perk; it’s how we deliver better for customers. We are fully committing to our customers by hiring top talent and collaborating seamlessly across time zones.
Global team, local impact.
Join a community of 60+ nationalities working across time zones, cultures, and disciplines, all aligned on doing great work for great brands.
High performance, low ego.
Work in a fast-paced, high-trust environment where feedback is direct, growth is constant, and kindness leads collaboration.
Impact meets opportunity.
We’re in the sweet spot — big enough to be stable, small enough for you to shape what’s next. Your ideas will matter here.
Grow fast. Lead well.
You’ll gain mentorship, take on real responsibility, and grow your career while helping us disrupt a global industry.

About Superside

Superside is the leading AI-powered creative company that quickly and cost-effectively enhances in-house functions. We help over 500 ambitious brands get great creative concepts done at scale. Built to be an extension 
of in-house teams, we unbottleneck marketing and creative teams so they can move faster and drive more reliable creative performance. 
Superside is a fully remote company with over 700 team members working across 60+ countries and 13 timezones.

Learn more at superside.com

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

We’re an equal-opportunity company. All applicants will be considered regardless of ethnicity, appearance, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, veteran or disability status.

Superside is looking for a Creative with a passion for Generative AI to produce exceptional design and visual content across branding, campaigns, and digital experiences. You’ll bring together creativity, craft, and curiosity to deliver human-centered work for some of the world’s leading brands, while helping evolve how we integrate AI into creative workflows.


As a hands-on maker, you combine strong visual execution with openness to experimentation. You thrive in collaboration, bring empathy and clarity to your work, and approach every project with a growth mindset. Superside is looking for a Cape Town based Video Content Creator who is a content creator at heart, comfortable in front of camera, constantly watching ads, and genuinely excited by the challenge of making paid social videos that people want to stop and watch.

We’re looking for someone obsessed with new video ideas: the person who sees a Meta ad, a LinkedIn post or a weird Instagram Reel and immediately starts deconstructing why it works. What was the hook? Why did the first three seconds land? Was it the pacing, the caption style, the camera angle, the way the problem was framed? This role is for someone who naturally brings references, has ten rough ideas in the back pocket, and wants to test formats instead of waiting for a perfect brief.

This is NOT a traditional video editor role. We’re not looking for someone who only wants to sit behind Premiere Pro and polish footage after the creative thinking is done. We need a hands-on creator who can help find the idea, shape the hook, appear on camera, storyboard the concept, support the shoot, and edit the final piece into something that feels sharp and native to the feed.

You’ll work side by side with our Marketing Video Lead in Cape Town, tag-teaming concepts, shoots and edits in our dedicated studio and on location. You’ll also collaborate remotely with Superside’s wider creative team, sometimes owning projects from idea to final edit, and other times contributing to larger campaigns led by others.

Your main focus will be creating advertising and brand content for Superside, including UGC-style ads, skits, direct-to-camera videos, explainers, campaign content and quick creative experiments. You’ll also support other teams across marketing on a varied mix of projects when your creative, production or on-camera skills are needed.

You care enough about B2B and SaaS to make the work feel specific, not generic. You've got the editing and sound design chops to work confidently in Premiere Pro, the visual sense to storyboard in Figma, and the curiosity to use AI to make the work sharper, faster and more unexpected.

Description

As an AI-First Developer on the R&D team, you will build AI-powered internal tools and data-driven systems that help teams across the organization make better decisions. You will work with behavioral and operational data from over 30 million websites that use our products - WPForms, MonsterInsights, OptinMonster, Easy Digital Downloads, and more - and turn that data into analytics platforms, reporting automation, workflow intelligence, and AI-powered features that real teams use every day.

This is not a WordPress development role. WordPress familiarity is a bonus for product context, but the core of this role is AI/ML engineering on top of an extraordinary data asset. You will sit between a Full Stack AI Developer and an AI ML Engineer - strong enough on the ML and data side to work intelligently with large-scale operational data, and product-minded enough to build tools that teams actually adopt.

Interested in applying?

Please read/follow the next steps outlined in "How to Apply" at the bottom of this listing.

Attention to detail is one of our core values! This is your chance to stand out :)

To love this role, here's the type of person you are:

  • You're a builder at heart. You don't just use AI tools - you understand how they work under the hood, and you think about how to make them useful for real people, not just technically impressive.
  • You're a self-starter who can take a loosely defined problem, figure out the right approach, and ship a working solution without needing to be told what to do next.
  • You think about the user and the decision first, not the pipeline and the model. When you see data, your first instinct is to ask what question it answers for the person who needs it.
  • You're comfortable owning the full stack of an AI project - from data exploration and model selection to building the API, deploying the service, and making sure it actually works in production.
  • You're an excellent communicator, fluent in both verbal and written English. You can explain complex technical decisions to non-technical stakeholders without dumbing it down.
  • You have the curiosity and desire to learn and grow your skills. The AI landscape moves fast and you keep up because you genuinely enjoy it, not because someone tells you to.
  • You take pride in the quality and craftsmanship of your work - clean code, proper error handling, thoughtful architecture, not just something that works on the happy path.
  • You're a team player who is comfortable working alongside other developers and doesn't take critical feedback personally.
  • You're excited about building internal tools and data systems that may not have a flashy frontend but have massive impact on how an organization operates.

Common responsibilities include (but are not limited to):

  • Building AI-powered internal tools and data-driven systems used across the organization - analytics platforms, reporting automation, workflow intelligence.
  • Developing AI/ML-driven platforms that process and analyze large-scale operational data from 30M+ sites across our product suite.
  • Designing and deploying RAG systems, LLM-powered features, and agentic workflows that generate actionable insights for internal teams.
  • Building data pipelines that ingest, transform, and serve behavioral and operational data at scale.
  • Prototyping and shipping AI solutions that streamline internal processes, reduce manual effort, and improve decision-making.
  • Evaluating and selecting the right models, frameworks, and infrastructure for each use case - balancing performance, cost, and latency.
  • Writing clean, well-tested, production-grade Python code with proper error handling, logging, and observability.
  • Collaborating with product teams and stakeholders to understand what they need, then building tools they actually use.
  • Keeping up with the rapidly evolving AI landscape and bringing new ideas, tools, and approaches to the team.
  • Communicating with the team and supporting your peers using chat, audio, and video.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of professional experience building AI/ML systems in production environments (not just POCs or hackathon projects).
  • Strong proficiency in Python, including production-grade practices - proper packaging, testing, type hints, async where appropriate.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM frameworks and tools: LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar. You should be able to build a RAG pipeline from scratch.
  • Experience with vector databases (Pinecone, ChromaDB, FAISS, Qdrant, or similar) and embedding models.
  • Solid understanding of ML fundamentals - not just API calls, but how models work, when to fine-tune vs prompt engineer, how to evaluate properly.
  • Experience building and deploying APIs (FastAPI, Flask, or similar) that serve ML models in production.
  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Experience with data processing at scale - SQL, pandas, Spark, or similar.
  • Competent with version control through Git and GitHub. Clean commit history, proper branching, code review through PRs.
  • The ability to iterate and ship ideas quickly without sacrificing code quality.
  • Exceptional troubleshooting skills - when something breaks in production at scale, you can diagnose it.
  • Ability to keep complex systems simple. Simplicity is a core value.
  • Previous remote work experience. You know how to manage your time, communicate proactively, and stay productive without supervision.
  • Personal computer with reliable internet access.
  • Availability to participate in audio/video meetings and be available on Slack between the hours of 9 AM - 1 PM EST daily.

Bonus points if you also have:

  • Experience with model fine-tuning (PEFT, LoRA, QLoRA) and quantization techniques for cost optimization.
  • Experience building multi-agent systems using CrewAI, LangGraph, AutoGen, or similar frameworks.
  • Familiarity with MLOps practices - model versioning, drift monitoring, experiment tracking (MLflow, Weights & Biases, etc).
  • Experience with Databricks, AWS SageMaker, or similar ML platforms.
  • Published research, open-source contributions, or technical writing that demonstrates depth of understanding.
  • Familiarity with the WordPress ecosystem, PHP, or SaaS product development. Understanding the end user (small business owners, bloggers, ecommerce operators) is valuable context.
  • Experience building internal tools and data platforms that non-technical teams rely on daily.
  • Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol), function calling, structured output, or similar LLM integration patterns.

Benefits

Working for a fast-growing bootstrapped company is a rare opportunity, one we consider a lifestyle choice rather than a job choice. Our positions are challenging, but also come with amazing advantages and fulfillment to those who earn them. Here's what we offer.

  • Competitive Salary.
  • Term Life Insurance and Accidental Death & Dismemberment for all full-time team members during their employment.
  • Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance benefits for full-time U.S. employees.
  • Health Insurance benefits for all employees in Argentina, Brazil, Egypt, India, Indonesia, Jamaica, Kenya, Mexico, Nepal, Nigeria, Pakistan, Philippines, Poland, Romania, Serbia, Spain, and Ukraine.
  • Work from your home. We're spread out all over the world – United States, Canada, Ukraine, India, Pakistan, Singapore, and more.
  • Flexible PTO after 90 days of employment. We encourage employees to take the time they need for a vacation, stay healthy, and spend time with friends and family.
  • Holidays (based on your location)
  • Paid Parental Leave.
  • We happily provide or reimburse software you'll need as well as books or courses that promote continued learning.
  • We cover all costs of company travel (including our annual all-company retreat and mini-team meetups).
  • Additional Perks include AM Welcome Box for new team members, Yearly Anniversary Gifts, and Technology Stipend each work anniversary.
  • We give you the opportunity to solve challenging and meaningful problems that make a difference.
  • Ability to work with some of the best people in the business through frequent, if not daily, interactions.
  • And in case you were wondering: no politics, no b.s., and no jerks.

Location

This is a remote position - our team is spread around the globe! Our home base is in Florida, USA, so company operating hours are 9am - 5pm ET (UTC -5). While full coverage is not a requirement, you must be available during a portion of the day.

Inclusion Statement

At Awesome Motive, we strive to have the broadest possible view of diversity, going beyond visible differences to include the background, experiences, skills, and perspectives that make each person unique. Awesome Motive is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other basis protected by federal, state, or local law.

How to apply?

If all of this sounds interesting, then please submit your application!

Please clearly include the following in your cover letter:

  • A brief walkthrough of your AI/ML journey - where you started, what you've built, and what kind of work excites you most.
  • The most impactful AI system you've built in production. What did it do, who used it, and what made it hard?
  • If you had access to behavioral data from 30 million websites - form submissions, conversion flows, email engagement, plugin usage - what is the first thing you would build and why?
  • Profile links with code samples (GitHub, GitLab, personal repos, published packages, etc).
  • Links to any published research, technical blog posts, or open-source contributions.
  • Other profile links if available (your website, Twitter/X, LinkedIn, etc).
  • Tell us a bit about yourself and why you should be considered. Details about your experience, qualifications, personality, etc are very helpful.

Also note, don't forget to proofread before submitting. Check spelling, capitalization, etc. This is your chance to make your application stand out :)

We won't be able to individually respond to all applications, but if we feel you're a strong match, someone will be in touch shortly.

Thanks and we look forward to hearing from you!

🌍 Global AI calling platform · $35.3M raised
🚀 Structured mentorship & upskilling
📍 Prague — new office on Náměstí Republiky · 5 days in-office (occasional home office by agreement)
💰 Base 40,000–55,000 CZK gross/month + monthly bonus up to 20% (quality & CSAT)

💻 Working hours: two options/shifts:
- Mon–Fri: 08:00–16:30, or
- Mon–Fri: 14:00–22:30

The Challenge Ahead

Support at CloudTalk is changing. Most routine answers now come from our internal AI assistant — and you are the person who makes that assistant trustworthy.

This isn't a ticket-closing role. You run every customer conversation through our AI, judge whether its answer is right, sharpen it when it isn't, and take over the moment the AI reaches its limit. In practice, you're the senior reviewer the AI answers to: you supervise it, escalate past it, and teach it to do better next time.

That means your work compounds. A ticket solved well helps one customer. A correction fed back into the AI helps every customer after. We're looking for people who see that difference and want to work at that level.

If you like understanding how systems behave, spotting patterns across hundreds of conversations, and telling a genuinely good answer from a plausible-but-wrong one, this role is built for you.

No previous VOIP experience required — we'll teach you the fundamentals. What matters most is logic, curiosity, technical comfort, and judgment.

And here's the part most support jobs can't offer: this is a real way into a product company. You'll learn how AI works, how to make it better, and how a product company actually runs — from the inside.

What You’ll Do

  • Run an AI-first workflow. Use CloudTalk's internal AI assistant on every conversation — review, refine, and approve its answer before it reaches the customer. You own the final response, not the AI.
  • Train the AI. Catch where it's wrong, outdated, or missing context, and feed structured corrections back so it improves over time.
  • Find what's missing. Identify gaps in the knowledge base, tooling, and integrations that keep the AI from resolving issues on its own — and flag or fix them.
  • Be the escalation point. When the AI can't solve something, you take over: investigate call flows, connectivity problems, audio quality, device setups, and configuration errors.
  • Diagnose VOIP issues — latency, jitter, firewalls, ISP behaviours, and similar edge cases.
  • Dig into the data. Inspect logs, replicate issues, and gather the detail L2 and Product need for deeper analysis.
  • Build the knowledge base. Write and improve articles that train both customers and the AI — clear, accurate, reusable.
  • Spot patterns. Surface recurring issues and automation opportunities across the conversations you and the AI handle.
  • Shape how AI does support here. Contribute to the prompts, workflows, and guardrails as we make AI native to every conversation.



Who We’re Looking For

🧠 A logical thinker. You enjoy puzzles, find root causes, and structure your thinking clearly.

🛠 Tech-savvy and curious. System settings, connection tests, and logs don't intimidate you. You don't need to be an engineer — but you dig in.

🤖 AI-fluent, or eager to be. You're comfortable working alongside AI tools: prompting them well, reading their output critically, and knowing when to trust them and when not to. This is core to the role.

👁 A critical eye. You can tell a correct answer from a confident-sounding wrong one. Supervising an AI well depends on it.

⚡ A problem-solver with ownership. You measure success by problems solved, not ticket volume. Proactive, responsible, set on getting things right.

💬 A strong communicator. Clear English at C1. Spanish is a plus.

🤝 A team player who shares knowledge. Curiosity and collaboration are part of our culture — and a teammate who teaches also teaches the AI.

Why Join CloudTalk

🤖 Work at the front of AI support. Help build the human-plus-AI support model for a platform used by thousands of sales and support teams worldwide, from scale-ups to enterprise.

💡 Meaningful technical work. Learn real VOIP fundamentals — call routing, number provisioning, latency, connectivity troubleshooting, platform logic — and how to make an AI reason about all of it.

🚀 A launchpad, not a destination. Breaking into a fast-moving AI SaaS company usually means already having an engineering or product background. This role is the exception — a genuine entry point into demanding, high-judgment work. You'll learn how AI reasons, how to make it measurably better, and how product gets built. From here, people grow into:

  • Product — including roles like AI Product Builder, shaping the AI that powers the platform
  • Technical & AI — L3 Engineer, Technical Consultant, Integration Specialist, and support-automation and AI-quality roles
  • Customer-facing careers — Account Manager, Customer Implementations, and beyond
  • Operations — Shift Lead

The work compounds, and so does your career: this is the door into CloudTalk, and it opens onto almost everything.

About CloudTalk

CloudTalk is THE global AI-powered business calling platform, trusted by 30,000+ professionals at companies like Nokia, Revolut, Glovo, and Uber.

We’re building the world’s most capable AI business calling software available in 160+ countries — helping businesses have more and better calls every day. Backed by $35.3M in funding from leading investors, including KPN Ventures, Point Nine, and HenQ, we're investing in making AI native to every conversation.

We're a ~200-person team that values growth, innovation, teamwork, customer focus, and human connection. We move fast, build for the future, and care deeply about creating products — and a culture — that people genuinely love.

Hiring Process

  1. Quick video interview
  2. Role deep dive: meet your future colleagues
  3. Assignment: work a real scenario inside our platform and AI assistant
  4. Culture Bar Raiser call — explore your potential to raise the bar in adaptability, ownership, and continuous improvement
  5. 🎯 Offer

Company Benefits

Growth:

💡 1-1 Coaching sessions with our resident communications advisor
🤖  Everything you need to do your best work with AI—from AI Champions and office hours to our AI L&D Hub and dedicated Slack support.

Flexibility:

🏖 Unlimited Paid Time Off
🎗️ Volunteering Days
💻 MacBook for work

Well-being:

🏖Recharge Fridays once per quarter
🏋🏼‍♀️ Multisport Card

Connectedness:

💲 Referral bonuses
👥 Virtual & physical team buildings
👕 Company merchandise

🌍 Global SaaS Scale-up | Series B
💡 Personalised 1:1 Coaching 
💰€3,300 - €4,200 gross/month (CZK 80k - 100k gross/month)

The Role

CloudTalk is building the next generation of AI-powered business communication. Our product is getting stronger every quarter. The gap we're closing now is the distance between a compelling product story and the conversion moment — the point where the right person, reading the right message at the right time, takes action.

This role owns that gap.

You will report directly to the Director of Product Marketing and work from CloudTalk's positioning and messaging as your source of truth. Your job is to translate strategy into copy, copy into campaigns, and campaigns into measurable funnel outcomes, and to do it with speed, structure, and a relentless focus on what actually moves the number.

The role operates on three tracks simultaneously.

The first is always-on: building and maintaining the conversion systems that compound over time — lifecycle campaigns, activation flows, onboarding sequences — monitoring their performance and raising the floor continuously.

The second is directional: when the company sets a step-change goal, you run the experiments and targeted fixes needed to reach that next level.

The third is launch activation: when PMM kicks off a product or feature launch, you are deployed to build the funnel structures that make it land — the campaigns, sequences, and conversion surfaces that turn launch momentum into measurable adoption and pipeline.

All three tracks can be live at the same time, and knowing how to balance them is part of the job

What You Will Own

Always-on conversion infrastructure

The lifecycle and activation systems running in the background — onboarding flows, trial nurture, re-engagement. You build them, monitor them on a regular cadence, and fix degradation before it becomes a problem. These are compounding assets: every improvement raises the baseline for good.

Directional experiments and growth pushes

When the company sets a step-change goal, you own the funnel strategy to hit it. Diagnose the friction blocking the goal, propose and build the interventions, and run structured experiments — moving fast from hypothesis to live test. Kill what fails, scale what works.

Launch activation

When PMM kicks off a launch, you're the conversion execution partner. PMM owns strategy, messaging, and project management; you own the funnel layer that makes it commercially successful — launch emails, in-app announcements, landing page variants, onboarding for new functionality, and post-launch adoption flows. Define the conversion goal up front (what success looks like at 7, 30, and 90 days), instrument it, and treat each launch as an experiment: set a baseline, run the plan, report what worked and what to change next time.

Automated campaign builds

Build and deploy lifecycle, trigger-based, and launch campaigns yourself — owning the setup, logic, segmentation, and QA of everything you ship. Keep the automation stack clean and documented so others can build on it.

Experimentation program

Run continuous A/B and multivariate tests across all three tracks. Stand up new engagement surfaces — a chat widget, an in-app tooltip series, a re-engagement sequence — as scoped experiments with defined success metrics. Document results rigorously: what you tested, learned, killed, and scaled.

Funnel diagnostics

Audit drop-off across the full journey — sign-up, activation, onboarding, expansion — on a rolling basis. Separate systemic issues (fix in the always-on layer) from acute friction (current growth push) and launch-specific gaps. Find the highest-leverage interventions and make the case for where to focus.

Compliance and list hygiene

Own GDPR consent and the cleanliness of the contact list, and govern who gets sent what. That means no unauthorized sends, keeping the list accurate and properly segmented, and owning the ability to send to all customers cleanly when needed (T&C updates and similar).

A note on copy: You don't need to be a professional copywriter, but you need to know what conversion copy looks like — enough to write a solid first draft, brief and direct an AI tool to produce variants, or work with a copywriter when the brief calls for it, and in every case tell the difference between copy that converts and copy that won't.

AI & Automation Mandate

This is not a nice-to-have. It is a core expectation of the role.

A significant portion of your time should be spent making yourself more effective through AI and automation — not as a productivity shortcut, but as a compounding investment. The goal is to build systems that reduce the cost of repetition, so your attention goes where judgment is actually required.

  • Audit your own workload. Anything you do more than twice in the same form — segmentation logic, copy variants, performance summaries, sequence drafts — is a candidate for automation. You decide whether to build it yourself or scope it with our AI team.
  • Build an automation stack you actually use. Not a collection of half-finished experiments but a working set of workflows that handles the repeatable parts of the job reliably.
  • Use AI as a force multiplier on experimentation. Generate copy variants at scale, synthesize results faster, pressure-test messaging against different audience segments before anything goes live.

  • Own the beginning of the customer journey – onboarding is the most important part of the customer's success, ensuring they see maximum value from CloudTalk from the get-go.
  • Drive timely product adoption
  • Be a trusted product expert – guide clients through best practices and help customers leverage advanced features.
  • Drive revenue retention & expansion – proactively identify opportunities for longer commitments, upsells and higher-tier plan advocacy.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • Customer-first mindset – you thrive on making customers successful.
  • Technical aptitude – you enjoy learning about software products inside out and can guide customers in leveraging their full potential.
  • Industry knowledge – experience in B2B SaaS
  • Proven experience – you’ve worked in Customer Success or Onboarding or SDR/BDR role in a SaaS company.
  • Familiarity with customer tools – experience using Zendesk, Custify, Planhat, or HubSpot is a plus.
  • Fluent in English, no other language is required

🚀 Why This Role Lands Perfectly for SDRs

  • A Natural Next Step into CX: This remains a highly business-oriented, consultative role. You will use your commercial instinct to spot expansion signals and navigate strategic conversations, just from the customer side of the table.
  • A Clear Path to Account Manager: Onboarding Consultants at CloudTalk quickly build deep product expertise, manage critical account relationships, and hone their commercial drive. This role is explicitly designed to lay the ground for a seamless transition into an Account Manager (AM) role.
  • Work at the AI Frontier: You won't just be onboarding users; you will be guiding hundreds of new customers monthly to implement AI-powered communication workflows that drive actual revenue.

Why You’ll Love Being a CloudTalker

🎯 3-step hiring process to offer

About CloudTalk

CloudTalk is THE global AI-powered business calling platform, trusted by 30,000+ professionals at companies like Nokia, Revolut, Glovo, and Uber.

We’re building the world’s most capable AI business calling software available in 160+ countries — helping businesses have more and better calls every day. Backed by $35.3M in funding from leading investors, including KPN Ventures, Point Nine, and HenQ, we're investing in making AI native to every conversation.

We're a ~200-person team that values growth, innovation, teamwork, customer focus, and human connection. We move fast, build for the future, and care deeply about creating products — and a culture — that people genuinely love.

The Challenge Ahead

CloudTalk is strategically expanding its presence in Tier 1 markets. For this reason, we've assembled a high-impact team in Barcelona and we're now on the lookout for a new Sales Development Representative (SDR).

As an SDR, you will be collaborating with our international team of 40 sales professionals located across Europe and the Americas, your primary responsibility will be connecting with clients globally and showcasing the value proposition of our AI business communications solution.

You'll be at the forefront of our growth engine, engaging with inbound prospects. Your mission? Forge meaningful relationships with potential customers by understanding their needs and demonstrating how our solution can address their challenges.

What's in it for you:

🚀 Be part of one of Europe’s fastest-growing SaaS companies
🤖 Sell cutting-edge AI products in a high-growth market
🌱Top-tier coaching & enablement – 1:1 sales training and mentorship to elevate your game

🎯 Have a front-row seat in our journey to $100M ARR

Ideal Candidate:

We are seeking enthusiastic and ambitious individuals who are eager to accelerate their careers in tech sales. You are driven by targets and thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where hitting KPIs is the norm.

You are not just looking for a job; you are passionate about building a long-term career in sales. You are highly engaged and ready to fully immerse yourself in our innovative, international SaaS scale-up. If you are highly motivated, disciplined and target-oriented, and excited about the opportunity to grow and succeed in a modern and dynamic setting, we want to hear from you!

What you will work on:

What makes you a great fit:

  • Experience: You bring some prior sales experience and a genuine passion for building a career in sales.

job.job_title: CISO / Head of IT Security - Fulltime Hybrid
job.job_description:
About Us

Ikerian AG (formerly RetinAI Medical) is a fast-growing medical device software company headquartered in Bern, Switzerland. Our mission is to enable the right decisions sooner in healthcare, through transformative AI & data management solutions for disease screening and monitoring. Join our diverse team of entrepreneurs, developers, researchers, and commercial experts who are collectively shaping the future of healthcare.

The Role

We are seeking a CISO / Head of IT Security to lead our security strategy and internal IT operations. This role is pivotal in safeguarding our digital assets and ensuring the highest standards of data privacy within the medical device software landscape. You will bridge the gap between technical security measures and the strategic needs of our growing global team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and implement the company-wide information security strategy and roadmap.
  • Oversee IT infrastructure, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security across all systems.
  • Lead compliance efforts for relevant standards such as ISO 27001, SOC2, HIPAA, and GDPR.
  • Manage risk assessments, vulnerability testing, and incident response protocols.
  • Supervise the procurement and management of hardware/software for a distributed workforce.
  • Foster a culture of security awareness through continuous training and policy development.

Requirements

  • 8 years of experience in a similar position (Finance sector start search)
  • Demonstrated entrepreneurial and collaborative mindset.
  • University degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field; professional certifications (CISSP, CISM) preferred.
  • Significant experience in information security and IT leadership, ideally within the healthcare or finance industry.
  • Expertise in cloud security architecture (AWS) and modern infrastructure tools.
  • Proven ability to manage complex IT projects and data privacy initiatives.
  • Strong leadership, stakeholder management, and communication skills.

Benefits

  • A chance to be part of an exceptional team driving innovation in healthcare.
  • A competitive salary in a supportive work environment that fosters work-life balance.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development in an international setting.

We are looking for a Business Developer to join our team, focused on the Pharma Segment. As a Business Developer you’ll identify new business opportunities in order to generate revenue, improve profitability and help the business grow. Your work will involve careful strategic planning and positioning in the appropriate markets, enhancing the operation of the business and our positioning in the market. The role, reporting to VP Business Development, will be part of a growing team

We are looking for Business Developers with a track record of consultative sales with Ophthalmology Pharma, Biotech , Real World Evidence and / or Clinical Research Organizations (CROs). You will be an independent thinker, a self starter comfortable with ambiguity and a results oriented problem solver. 

This role is pivotal in scaling our business development efforts. 

Responsibilities:

    • Have a good understanding of the RetinAI / Ikerain current and evolving portfolio of products and services and be able to advise others about them
    • Research and identify targets in the segments we are interested in (Pharma, Biotech and CROs focused on eye care)
    • Identify and seek out appropriate contacts in target organizations, leveraging publicly available sources and personal networks 
    • Generate leads and cold call prospective customers 
    • Meet with prospects and customers face to face or over the phone
    • Develop compelling pitches based on analysis of the organization and potential customer needs
    • Foster and develop relationships with prospects and customers
    • Understand the needs of your potential customers and be able to respond effectively with a plan of how to meet these
    • Think strategically - seeing the bigger picture and setting aims and objectives in order to develop and improve the business, and identify new opportunities in target markets and adjacent segments 
    • Work strategically - carrying out necessary planning in order to implement changes, for example working closely with Customer Success, Research, Marketing,Product and Operational colleagues
    • Draw up client contracts working with relevant internal teams (operations and legal)
    • Support the onboarding of new customers, working closely with Customer Success and members of the broader team to ensure the successful start to the project and transition of the relationship to account management
    • Manage and grow accounts from project to project

Requirements

  • Demonstrated entrepreneurial and collaborative mindset
  • Bachelor’s degree ideally in life sciences, computer science or related field, PhD/ MBA a plus
  • 5+ years of experience in business development management consulting or other customer-facing role, experience of scale - up environments a plus 
  • Proven track record of consultative sales with Ophthalmology Pharma, Biotech, MedTech and / or Clinical Research Organizations (CROs)
  • Tech savvy ideally with experience in digital health or health IT 
  • Experience working with cross functional teams (sales, marketing, development)
  • Experience working with complex, multi-divisional, multi-geographical customers; experience in healthcare environments (i.e. clinics and hospitals) a plus
  • Strong interpersonal skills with impressive executive presence and communication abilities
  • Tenacity and drive to seek new business and meet or exceed targets
  • Technical aptitude and ability to learn 
  • Ability to create structure in ambiguous situations to design and implement effective processes 
  • A strong drive for action and a passion for technology and customer success

Skills 

  • Ability to think strategically
  • Negotiating skills
  • Ability to analyze sales figures and write reports
  • Flexible approach to work with the ability to adapt to a fast-paced, ever-changing environment
  • Initiative taking and confidence to start things from scratch
  • Project management and organizational skills
  • Team Working skills and a collaborative approach to work
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Experience with Customer Relationship Management software such as Hubspot

Benefits

    • A chance to be part of an exceptional team driving innovation in healthcare.
    • A competitive salary in a supportive work environment that fosters work-life balance.
    • Opportunities for professional growth and development in an international setting.
    • A culture of collaboration and inclusion, which is fundamental to our ethos.
    • Occasional travel to our HQ in Switzerland, immersing you in our core operations and company culture.

Your work will involve careful strategic planning and positioning in the appropriate markets, enhancing the operation of the business and our positioning in the market. The role, reporting to VP Business Development, will be part of a growing team.

Key Responsibilities

Market Intelligence & Strategic Planning

  • Build and maintain an in-depth understanding of RetinAI’s evolving software and services portfolio to confidently advise and educate prospective clients.
  • Actively research, map, and update intelligence on target organizations across eye-care-focused Pharma, Biotech, and CRO segments.
  • Identify new market opportunities and adjacent segments, setting clear long-term business development objectives.

Pipeline & Deal Generation

  • Proactively identify and engage key decision-makers within target organizations using personal networks, industry databases, and cold outreach.
  • Analyze prospect workflows and clinical needs to develop and deliver highly compelling, tailored solution pitches (remotely and in-person).
  • Lead the commercial proposal process, collaborating closely with internal legal and operational teams to draft and finalize client contracts.

Account Management & Internal Collaboration

  • Partner with Customer Success, Research, Marketing, and Product teams to ensure seamless client onboarding and a successful project kick-off.
  • Foster and deepen senior-level client relationships, ensuring high customer satisfaction to expand accounts from project-based deals to long-term enterprise partnerships.

Requirements

Education & Core Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Computer Science, or a related field; an MBA or PhD is a strong plus.
  • 5+ years of experience in business development, client executive roles, or management consulting, with a preference for fast-paced scale-up environments.
  • A proven track record of consultative sales within Ophthalmology Pharma, Biotech, MedTech, or Clinical Research Organizations (CROs).
  • Experience managing complex, multi-divisional, and multi-geographical client accounts, including healthcare environments (clinics and hospitals).

Technical & Operational Skills

  • Domain knowledge in digital health, health IT, or software platforms, with a strong technical aptitude and a passion for technology.
  • Demonstrated success working alongside cross-functional internal teams, including Sales, Marketing, Operations, and Product Development.
  • Ability to navigate ambiguous environments by creating structure, designing workflows, and implementing effective new processes.

Mindset & Interpersonal Attributes

  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the confidence to engage and influence stakeholders at the executive level.
  • A tenacious, results-driven professional with an entrepreneurial mindset and a proven commitment to meeting or exceeding sales targets.

Skills 

  • Strategic & Autonomous Execution: A self-starter who thinks strategically, takes the initiative to build processes from scratch, and works effectively both independently and within teams.
  • Commercial Acumen & Negotiation: Strong negotiation skills combined with the ability to analyze sales metrics, interpret data, and compile actionable reports.
  • Agility & Problem-Solving: A results-oriented problem solver who thrives in fast-paced, ambiguous, and rapidly evolving scale-up environments.
  • Organization & Tools: Solid project management and organizational skills, with hands-on proficiency in CRM platforms like HubSpot.

Benefits

  • A chance to be part of an exceptional team driving innovation in healthcare.
  • A competitive salary in a supportive work environment that fosters work-life balance.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development in an international setting.
  • A culture of collaboration and inclusion, which is fundamental to our ethos.
  • Occasional travel to our HQ in Switzerland, immersing you in our core operations and company culture.

job.job_title: Cloud Engineer (AWS) Full Time - Remote EU
job.job_description:
About Us

Ikerian AG (formerly RetinAI Medical) is a fast-growing medical device software company headquartered in Bern, Switzerland. Our mission is to enable the right decisions sooner in healthcare, through transformative AI & data management solutions for disease screening and monitoring. Join our diverse team of entrepreneurs, developers, researchers, and commercial experts who are collectively shaping the future of healthcare.

Job Description

We are looking for a Cloud Engineer to join our team, where you will play a critical role in optimizing our cloud infrastructure to meet our customers’ needs. This position is pivotal to our mission of providing a seamless, secure, and scalable experience on our platform

Key Responsibilities

  • Enhance and maintain highly available, secure, and scalable AWS cloud environments and services.
  • Manage and prioritize tasks in the cloud infrastructure backlog to address immediate needs and plan long-term improvements.
  • Set up infrastructure monitoring and observability solutions, proactively addressing availability, performance or security issues.
  • Learn the current infrastructure and take ownership of day to day cloud operational tasks and activities.
  • Assess new technologies, systems, and services for production readiness, ensuring seamless and stable integration.
  • Prepare and maintain documentation on cloud processes, procedures, and architectures to ensure clear understanding and team-wide knowledge.
  • Apply AWS Well-Architected Framework principles to evaluate and optimize our current infrastructure.
  • Contribute in out of office hour cloud deployments once or twice a month
  • Conduct POCs (proof of concepts) on new AWS services, third-party tools, and technologies to drive continuous improvement in our infrastructure.

Requirements

  • A demonstrated entrepreneurial and collaborative mindset with a proactive approach to problem-solving.
  • A university degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • 3-5 years of hands-on experience with AWS cloud services in a professional setting.
  • Proficiency with core AWS services, including IAM, S3, KMS, RDS, VPC, ECS, EC2, and more.
  • Experience working with multi-account and multi-region AWS production environment setups and using IaaC to manage them.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools, preferably Terraform.
  • Scripting experience with one or more languages, such as Python, Bash, or Node.js.
  • Good knowledge of cloud security principles and services, such as AWS WAF, GuardDuty, Config and CloudTrail.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and tools preferably GitLab
  • Experience with software version control and Git.
  • Strong understanding of cloud networking concepts, including VPC, VPC Peering, Subnets, and Load Balancing.
  • Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools for cloud environments, such as Grafana, Prometheus, OpenSearch, and the ELK stack.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a proactive approach to challenges.
  • A genuine interest in staying updated with new AWS services and features, integrating advancements into the cloud environment.
  • Ability to work well in a flexible, startup environment, taking initiative to establish new processes when necessary.
  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.
  • Good listening skills.
  • Familiarity with industry best practices in cloud architecture principles.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team setting.
  • Availability to work during Central European Time (CET) business hours.

Benefits

What We Offer

  • A chance to be part of an exceptional team driving innovation in healthcare.
  • A competitive salary in a supportive work environment that fosters work-life balance.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development in an international setting.
  • A culture of collaboration and inclusion, which is fundamental to our ethos.
  • Occasional travel to our HQ in Switzerland, immersing you in our core operations and company culture.

job.job_title: Head of Commercial - Full Time - CH
job.job_description:
About Us

Ikerian AG (formerly RetinAI, now part of Essilor Luxottica) is a fast-growing software company headquartered in Bern, Switzerland. Our mission is to enable the right decisions sooner in healthcare, through transformative AI & data management solutions to better understand patients and diseases. Join our diverse team of entrepreneurs, developers, researchers, and commercial experts who are collectively shaping the future of healthcare and eyecare.

Job Description

The Head of Commercial is the head of Ikerian’s market footprint and global revenue growth. Your mission is to optimize a complex revenue mix spanning scalable clinical SaaS, bespoke research collaborations, and Data-Driven Intelligence solutions for the pharma and clinical segment. You will professionalize our commercial engine by ensuring operational excellence while bridging the gap between innovation and global demand. As a key leader within the company and the EssilorLuxottica ecosystem, you will orchestrate strategic partnerships and implement new commercial concepts across global distribution models to maximize corporate synergies.

Key Responsibilities

  • Direct and execute the commercial strategy for multiple revenue streams, balancing clinics sales with high-value life science and pharma services and bespoke research collaborations.
  • Orchestrate the expansion of data-driven intelligence solutions (including RWE and Candidate Identification), establishing high-value partnerships to deliver advanced clinical insights to the industry.
  • Partner with EssilorLuxottica leadership to execute group-wide commercial synergies, such as retail expansion and clinical distribution via the global affiliate network.
  • Leverage and empower internal subject matter expertise to deepen Key Opinion Leader (KOL) relationships and strategic partnerships, ensuring our commercial voice remains scientifically rigorous.
  • Institutionalize a data-driven sales methodology and modern workflows, defining a cadence and rhythm that is tracked through a commercial record to ensure scalable and professionalized growth.
  • Provide leadership and mentorship to the commercial team to ensure a unified approach to revenue generation.
  • Professionalize the end-to-end commercial financial lifecycle by standardizing pricing tiers and commission structures while optimizing the quote-to-cash cycle to ensure all contracts are aligned with accurate resource costing and seamless invoicing.
  • Collaborate with the Research department to align market demand with project selection, establishing clear resource-allocation frameworks that balance immediate financial performance with long-term strategic R&D value.
  • Translate market intelligence and competitor trends into proactive commercial strategies, ensuring customer needs directly inform the technical roadmap and position Ikerian as a strategic partner to both pharma, clinics and clinical networks.
  • Transform Customer Operations into a value-driven "Success" engine that maximizes lifetime value (LTV) through renewals, expansions, and upselling.
  • Oversee brand strategy and marketing execution to ensure Ikerian remains a distinctive, top-of-mind leader at international conferences and digital channels.
  • Monitor and optimize company-wide revenue KPIs, delivering transparent reporting on ARR, project margins, and pipeline velocity to drive strategic decision-making.

Requirements

  • Degree in Business/STEM/Law (MBA/PhD preferred). Fluent English + a major European language (DE/IT/FR) preferred. Swiss/EU work authorization required.
  • Proven track record in scaling software solutions within the healthcare sector, with specific expertise in navigating the procurement and implementation cycles of pharma, large-scale hospital systems and clinical networks.
  • Demonstrated ability to design "Value-Exchange" business models, specifically regarding the use of software platforms to facilitate data acquisition and commercialization.
  • Strong background in consultative selling to Life Science stakeholders such as Big Pharma, with a record of closing large, long-cycle deals that require significant market education.
  • Ability to orchestrate a multi-revenue model, balancing the differing cadences of clinical software and pharma research services.
  • Strong foundation in partnership strategy, specifically negotiating complex data-sharing, distribution, or collaboration agreements.
  • Senior experience scaling HealthTech, MedTech, or Life Science B2B enterprise software during a high-growth phase. Ophthalmology and regulatory (MDR/FDA) expertise is a plus.
  • Experience in commercial financial governance including the ability to manage departmental budgets and oversee contract negotiations. 
  • Demonstrated expertise in Data-Driven Revenue Management, including the professionalization of CRMs and standardized commercial KPIs.
  • Experience in strategic organizational design and leadership, building incentive models and workflows that align Sales with the rest of the organization.
  • Willingness to travel globally to represent Ikerian at leadership events and clinical conferences.

Benefits

  • A unique opportunity to lead the evolution of a high-tech healthcare AI subsidiary within a world-leading healthcare group.
  • A competitive compensation package in a supportive environment that values work-life balance.
  • The chance to shape the future of digital health and AI-driven eye care.
  • A central role in a diverse, international team driving meaningful innovation for patients worldwide.

About Us

Ikerian AG (formerly RetinAI Medical, now part of Essilor Luxottica) is a fast-growing medical device software company headquartered in Bern, Switzerland. Job Description

The Head of Operations is the head of Ikerian’s operational maturity and global scaling. Your mission is to install a high-performance 'Operating System’ that synchronizes Research, Development, and Commercial engines into a unified machine, driven by scalable organizational processes and the leadership of cross-functional teams including Project Management, Human Resources,and Quality & Regulatory Affairs. As the primary custodian of our external ecosystem, you will professionalize our vendor management and institutionalize our internal knowledge infrastructure and processes. Following Ikerian’s acquisition by EssilorLuxottica, you will lead the evolution from a high-growth startup to a world-class subsidiary, ensuring our complex dual-business model is anchored by a robust, compliant, and transparent operational framework.

  • Direct the company’s core operational departments, providing executive leadership and mentorship to the heads of PMO, QRA, and HR.

  • Professionalize the vendor management lifecycle, overseeing the selection, compliance, and performance of all external service providers and partners.

  • Oversee the HR and Talent Acquisition strategy to scale headcount and foster a high-performance culture that attracts and retains world-class talent.

  • Demonstrated expertise in building and professionalizing "Operating Systems" to synchronize cross-functional teams and minimize departmental silos.

  • Direct experience navigating complex regulatory pathways (such as FDA or MDR), or highly regulated environments and managing internal Quality Management Systems. 
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multi-faceted projects involving complex technical, legal, and human resource components.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with an eye for operational detail and financial efficiency.

Benefits

  • A central role in a diverse, international team driving meaningful innovation for patients worldwide.

job.job_title: Head of QRA - Full Time - CH
job.job_description:
About Us

Ikerian AG (formerly RetinAI Medical) is a fast-growing medical device software company headquartered in Bern, Switzerland. Our mission is to enable the right decisions sooner in healthcare, through transformative AI & data management solutions for disease screening and monitoring. Join our diverse team of entrepreneurs, developers, researchers, and commercial experts who are collectively shaping the future of healthcare.

Job Description

We are looking for a Head of Quality & Regulatory Affairs (QRA) to join our company in Bern, Switzerland. This role is pivotal in driving our internal operational maturity and ensuring global compliance across our expanding product portfolio. Following Ikerian’s acquisition by EssilorLuxottica, you will lead the evolution of the QRA department from a high-growth startup environment to a world-class subsidiary operation. You will oversee global product clearances for Software as a Medical Device (SaMD), optimize our Quality Management System (QMS), and serve as a strategic partner to internal R&D, Research, and global sister companies like Heidelberg Engineering.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and mentor a global QRA team located across various time zones, establishing a supportive, high-performance team culture driven by clear accountability, structured goal-setting, and skills development.
  • Act as the legal Person Responsible for Regulatory Compliance (PRRC) under EU MDR to ensure device conformity, keep technical documentation up to date, and oversee post-market surveillance and vigilance reporting obligations.
  • Develop and execute robust global regulatory strategies with an emphasis on securing and maintaining rapid market access via FDA submissions and CE-MDR compliance frameworks.
  • Govern and scale a world-class Quality Management System (QMS) ensuring continuous organizational readiness for ISO 13485 and the Medical Device Single Audit Program (MDSAP).
  • Serve as the primary corporate representative during all internal, Notified Body, partner, and health authority audits to ensure the continuous validation of corporate certifications.
  • Establish structured cross-functional alignment with R&D to seamlessly integrate design controls, risk management, and software lifecycles into early product development stages.
  • Partner with the IT Infrastructure and Security functions to support data privacy governance frameworks including GDPR and HIPAA compliance while aligning quality processes with emerging cybersecurity standards.
  • Translate market intelligence and evolving global regulations into proactive compliance roadmaps to ensure customer specifications and changing health authority standards are built into the corporate lifecycle.

Requirements

  • University degree in Life Sciences, Biomedical Engineering, Law, or a relevant scientific discipline; a PhD or MBA is a strong asset.
  • A minimum of 10 years of professional experience with a documented track record of successfully leading, managing, and mentoring cross-functional quality and regulatory teams.
  • A minimum of 8-10 years of dedicated industry experience in medical device Quality and Regulatory Affairs specifically focused on Software as a Medical Device (SaMD).
  • Proven track record as a legal Person Responsible for Regulatory Compliance (PRRC) with deep experience managing complex technical files for EU MDR and FDA submissions.
  • Expert technical knowledge of ISO 13485, EU MDR, IEC 62304 software lifecycles, ISO 14971 risk management, and FDA 21 CFR Part 820. Formal Lead Auditor certification is highly valued.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multi-faceted projects involving complex technical, clinical data, and regulatory evaluation components across international borders.
  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with an exceptional eye for process detail, operational efficiency, and structural quality.
  • Demonstrated entrepreneurial and collaborative mindset with excellent team-building and conflict-resolution capabilities.
  • Ability to work independently as a leader.
  • Available to work during Central European Time (CET) business hours with a regular physical presence at our Bern headquarters.

Benefits

What We Offer

  • A chance to be part of an exceptional global team driving innovation in healthcare.
  • A competitive salary in a supportive work environment that fosters work-life balance.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development in an international setting.
  • A culture of collaboration and inclusion, which is fundamental to our ethos.
  • Occasional travel to our HQ in Switzerland, immersing you in our core operations and company culture.
